summary_md: **Kenny ([@lwrf42](https://x.com/lwrf42/status/2115842574267416622))** built **compactlab**, an MIT local tool that replays your agent history against auto-compaction thresholds; for 24 days of 1M-context sessions, compacting at 625K instead of ~967K was an estimated 22% cheaper and about 3 min/day slower, after correcting for the one-hour prompt cache tier; it also reads DeepSeek Harness logs ([LemonCANDY42/compactlab](https://github.com/LemonCANDY42/compactlab)).

referenced_urls.title: GitHub - LemonCANDY42/compactlab: Measure where to auto-compact from your own agent history: cost vs context-rot trade-offs per model and role. Local, zero-token, MIT.

relevance: Data-driven context compaction tuning for harnesses.
